description: List policies registered on the running OPA server. Returns the policy IDs and a count. Set `includeSource` for the Rego text of every policy, or `includeAst` for the parsed AST of every policy; both are off by default because either one pushes a list of any real size past the response cap.

includeAst.description: Include each policy's parsed AST. Off by default; it is roughly forty times the size of the source and will exceed the response cap on all but the smallest servers.

includeSource.description: Include each policy's Rego source. Off by default: fetch one policy with `opa_get_policy` rather than every policy at once.

name: opa_list_policies
title: List OPA policies
